Privacy Policy

Last updated: 14 October 2026 — WEBSITE-INQUIRY-2026-10-14-2.

1. Who we are

VisionCraft Labs operates this website and handles project inquiries. Business correspondence address: 163-X, Street 6, Phase 3, DHA Cantt, Lahore, Pakistan. Contact: info@visioncraft-labs.com.

2. Project inquiries

The contact form asks for your name, email address and project description. Company, phone or WhatsApp number, project type, budget and timeline provide context. Optional details may be left blank. Please do not submit passwords, activation keys, payment card details, identity documents or sensitive personal information.

Submitting the form sends your inquiry to our business inbox and a branded receipt acknowledgement to the email address you provide. We use it to respond, assess your requirements and prepare project discussions or proposals. An inquiry does not subscribe you to promotional messages or create a demo account.

3. Service providers and processing locations

Netlify hosts this website and processes the form request through a server-side function. Resend sends the notification and receives it in our branded business inbox. The notification uses your email address as Reply-To so we can respond. Our staff in Pakistan can access these messages. Resend's email dispatch is configured in Ireland; its service data is stored in the United States. Provider infrastructure may process data outside your country.

Hosting providers also process technical request information, such as IP addresses, timestamps and browser or device information, to operate, secure and troubleshoot the service. Our form handler does not deliberately log the inquiry body or credentials.

4. Retention and access

We review inquiry correspondence and delete or anonymise inquiries that have not become an active engagement within 12 months of the last meaningful contact, unless a dispute, legal obligation or documented business need requires longer retention. Active engagements have a separately agreed record schedule. Provider logs and message records have their own retention schedules; Resend's standard email records are retained for 30 days, while its beta inbox storage is subject to the provider's applicable terms. We will handle business-inbox deletion manually under this practice.

Access is limited to authorised people and service providers needed to operate the service. We do not sell inquiry information or use it to train an AI inbox agent.

5. Links, fonts and browser controls

Direct email links open your own mail app. WhatsApp and social links take you to the relevant provider, whose privacy practices apply. Pages load fonts from Fontshare; external services may receive technical request information when assets load. This form release adds no advertising cookies, open tracking or click tracking. You can control cookies and storage through your browser settings.

6. Questions and privacy requests

Contact info@visioncraft-labs.com to ask about an inquiry or request access, correction or deletion. We may need reasonable information to verify your request and will respond according to applicable requirements. We do not treat this notice as a certification of compliance in every country.
